summary.text: Dana Jones is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 30A, in Anne Arundel County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A longtime Democratic campaign and research professional, she has served in the House since 2020 and is a member of the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jones was born in Cumberland, Maryland, attended Fort Hill High School, and earned a B.S. in sociology from Towson University in 1998.

Her career included work as a legislative assistant to Congressman Benjamin L. Cardin, senior research analyst at the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee, and research and strategy director at EMILY's List.
Gov. Larry Hogan appointed Jones to the House of Delegates on April 23, 2020, following the resignation of Alice Cain, and she was sworn in on May 1, 2020.
She was elected to a full term in November 2022.
She serves on the Appropriations Committee, where she is vice chair of the Health and Social Services Subcommittee, and holds the position of Deputy Speaker Pro Tem in 2026.
She served as president of the Women Legislators of Maryland in 2025-2026.
